translation.name: Coin pouch
profile: A coin pouch is a simple place to keep coins and small personal possessions. In Elaria, it may be an ordinary purchase, a homemade item, or a memento of someone who helped the hero before their first journey. A mark on its fastening or unusual contents can create a small clue whose significance becomes clear later.

It keeps small items organized, but grants neither unlimited space nor automatic protection against loss. Finding a pouch offers a scene centered on deciding whom it belongs to and whether to return it. The item itself improves neither bargaining nor luck. A message, unfamiliar coin, or personal keepsake the party discovers inside may matter more.

Rules effect: Carrying coins and small items. The price is 1 sp. The item is reusable rather than a single-use supply. Its listed effect applies to the situation it is intended for. Additional bonuses, other forms of protection, and new magical abilities are not part of this entry.

strings.Přesný řádek této položky má přednost př: This item's exact entry overrides the general formula only where explicitly stated. Vaelor does not add any further hidden bonuses.
